items_all.title: Anthropic opens Claude AI text detection to regulators, media, fact-checkers, and others
items_all.summary: Anthropic is launching an API that lets regulators, media outlets, and researchers check whether text carries Claude's digital watermark. The EU AI Act now requires invisible watermarks in AI-generated text. Critics warn the technology could hurt text quality and create transparency problems where contracts ban AI use. The article Anthropic opens Claude AI text detection to regulators, media, fact-checkers, and others appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Anthropic 正在推出一個應用程式介面 (API)，允許監管機構、媒體和研究人員檢查文字是否帶有 Claude's 數位浮水印。歐盟人工智慧法案現已要求在人工智慧生成的文字中新增不可見的浮水印。批評人士警告稱，這項技術可能會損害文字品質，並在合約禁止使用人工智慧的情況下造成透明度問題。文章《Anthropic 向監管機構、媒體、事實查核機構和其他機構開放 Claude 人工智慧文字偵測功能》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items_all.title: Researchers from Princeton, Ant Group and Stanford Introduce AQuA: A Two-Part Agentic Framework for Autonomous Factor Discovery and Model Development in Quantitative Finance
items_all.summary: Quantitative research agents that write their own experiments can corrupt the evidence they later learn from. A leaky feature that scores well gets stored as a successful precedent and propagated through later iterations. Prompt-level instructions and reviewer agents do not close this, because author and reviewer share the same blind spots. A team of researchers […] The post Researchers from Princeton, Ant Group and Stanford Introduce AQuA: A Two-Part Agentic Framework for Autonomous Factor Discovery and Model Development in Quantitative Finance appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: 能夠自行編寫實驗的定量研究代理可能會破壞它們之後從中學習到的證據。一個得分很高但有缺陷的特徵會被儲存為成功的先例，並在後續迭代中傳播。提示級指示和審閱代理無法解決這個問題，因為作者和審閱者有相同的盲點。一個研究團隊…[文章標題：來自普林斯頓大學、螞蟻集團和史丹佛大學的研究人員推出 AQuA：用於定量金融中自主因子發現和模型開發的雙部分代理框架] 這篇文章最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.title: Google's election AI Overviews are opaque, rely on few sources, and sometimes take sides
items_all.summary: Using access granted under the EU's Digital Services Act, the German advocacy group AlgorithmWatch ran 4,480 election-related search queries on Google and analyzed the AI Overviews that came back. Google showed the overviews inconsistently and leaned on a small pool of sources, chief among them its own platform YouTube. Whether earlier safeguards against AI answers on election questions still apply, Google left open. The article Google's election AI Overviews are opaque, rely on few sources, and sometimes take sides appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 德國倡導組織AlgorithmWatch利用歐盟《數位服務法》授予的存取許可權，在Google平臺上進行了4480次與選舉相關的搜尋查詢，並分析了返回的AI概覽。 Google平臺顯示的概覽並不一致，且依賴少量資訊來源，其中最主要的是其自身的YouTube平臺。 Google平臺並未明確說明先前針對AI在選舉議題上作答的保障措施是否仍然有效。文章《Google's選舉AI概覽晦澀難懂、資訊來源有限且有時帶有傾向性》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

items_all.title: ChatGPT、Reddit及Roblox被納入歐盟《數位服務法》規範
items_all.summary: 歐盟執委會（European Commission，EC）週一（8/31）宣佈，將ChatGPT納入《數位服務法》（Digital Services Act，DSA）超大型線上搜尋引擎（Very Large Online Search Engine，VLOSE）名單，Reddit與Roblox則被列為超大型線上平臺（Very Large Online Platform，VLOP），即日起適用DSA最嚴格規範，須於四個月內、即2027年1月前完成合規。

items_all.title: 應對AI漏洞挑戰，FIRST國際資安應變組織擴大漏洞研討會規模
items_all.summary: 當AI打破漏洞修補節奏，過往資安團隊尚有餘裕應對的漏洞修補時程，如今正被大幅壓縮，如何在漏洞被發現或遭AI加速利用之前重新調整應對策略，已成為產業界迫切需要解決的課題，最近FIRST國際資安應變組織宣佈，將於9月23日至25日召開VulnOptiCON 2026，將原本的Vuln4Cast研討會更名並擴大舉辦，不僅將會期拉長為3日，議程主軸也從原本以漏洞預測技術為核心，擴大納入漏洞追蹤、CVE計畫前景，以及AI如何改變漏洞發現及利用等議題，以涵蓋更廣泛的漏洞生態系統主題。

items_all.title: Why MCP servers are becoming AI’s newest attack surface
items_all.summary: As AI adoption gathers pace, so does the evolution of the infrastructure that supports it. New standards and connectors keep appearing, and the ones that catch on spread through the ecosystem within months rather than years. That speed strengthens what AI can do, but makes it very difficult for security teams to maintain sufficient protections. […] The post Why MCP servers are becoming AI’s newest attack surface appeared first on AI News .
items_all.summary_zh: 隨著人工智慧的普及，支撐其發展的基礎設施也加速演進。新的標準和連接器層出不窮，那些被廣泛接受的方案往往只需幾個月而非幾年就能在整個生態系統中傳播開來。這種快速發展增強了人工智慧的能力，但也使得安全團隊難以維持足夠的防護。 […] 這篇文章《為什麼 MCP 伺服器正成為人工智慧最新的攻擊面》最初發表於 AI News。

items_all.title: Claude Fable 5.1 made me a really nice animated pelican
items_all.summary: Today is Claude Fable (and Mythos) 5.1 day . Anthropic say that Fable 5.1 "sets a new standard for coding, knowledge work, and long-running problem-solving tasks". Their announcement spends a notable amount of time on scientific research, boasting of a 52.6% score on the brand new Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 benchmark (first announced on August 27th ), up from 24.7% for Fable 5, 29.0% for Opus 5 and 22.4% for GPT-5.6 Sol. Other benchmarks show slightly improved scores, but none as impressive as the Science one. But how well can it pelican? Back in July I wrote about how I was losing faith in the pelican benchmark - its connection to how good the models were at other tasks didn't seem to hold as strongly as it did back in 2025 . The most interesting insights I get from it now are comparisons within model families, and particularly comparisons for the same prompt at different reasoning effort levels. Fable 5.1 has five reasoning levels: low, medium, high, xhigh, max - and no option to turn off reasoning entirely. I fixed an issue in llm-anthropic which caused reasoning traces not to be correctly recorded, then ran some prompts. Here's the full set of pelicans for all of the reasoning levels, each with the full reasoning transcript. I'll replicate them here: Low and medium, both without reasoning? Next, a bit of a mystery. This is what I got for effort low : The transcript doesn't show any summarized reasoning tokens, and the output token count is 1,998. With Claude that output token count includes reasoning tokens. It took 23.8 seconds and cost 10.017 cents . I bumped that up
items_all.summary_zh: 今天是 Claude Fable（以及 Mythos）5.1 版本發布日。 Anthropic 聲稱 Fable 5.1「為編碼、知識工作和長時間運行的問題解決任務樹立了新的標竿」。他們的公告用了大量篇幅介紹科學研究，並自豪地宣稱其在全新的 Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 基準測試（於 8 月 27 日首次發布）中取得了 52.6% 的分數，高於 Fable 5 的 24.7%、Opus 5 的 29.0% 和 Fable 5 的 1其他基準測試的分數略有提高，但沒有一項能像科學基準測試那樣令人印象深刻。但是，它的表現究竟如何呢？早在 7 月份，我就寫過我對 Pelican 基準測試失去信心——它與模型在其他任務上的表現之間的關聯性似乎不如 2025 年時那麼強了。現在我從中獲得的最有趣的見解是模型家族內部的比較，特別是同一提示在不同推理難度下的比較。 Fable 5.1 有五個推理難度：低、中、高、超高和最高——而且沒有完全關閉推理的選項。我修復了 llm-anthropic 中的一個問題，該問題導致推理軌跡無法正確記錄，然後運行了一些提示。以下是所有推理難度下的完整鵜鶘圖集，每個圖集都包含完整的推理記錄。我將在這裡復現它們：低難度和中難度，都沒有推理？接下來，有點神祕。這是我在低難度下得到的結果：記錄中沒有顯示任何總結的推理標記，輸出標記數為 1,998。而 Claude 的輸出標記數包含推理標記。耗時 23.8 秒，成本為 10.017 美分。我提高了這個值。 GPT-5.6 Sol

items_all.title: Codex bundles LibreOffice
items_all.summary: I was poking around in my ~/.cache/ folder using OmniDiskSweeper when I spotted something interesting. The OpenAI Codex desktop app (since rebranded to just ChatGPT) has 1.7GB of stuff in there in a folder called codex-primary-runtime , including a full Python installation, a full Node.js installation, and native binaries for Poppler , git, and the LibreOffice open source office suite (which forked from OpenOffice.org in 2010): The ~/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/plugins/openai-primary-runtime/plugins/documents folder includes skills which tell Codex how to find and use those binaries. Tags: codex , generative-ai , openai , ai , llms , openoffice , open-source
items_all.summary_zh: 當我用 OmniDiskSweeper 在我的 ~/.cache/ 資料夾裡閒逛時，發現了一些有趣的東西。 OpenAI Codex 桌面應用程式（現已更名為 ChatGPT）在名為 codex-primary-runtime 的資料夾中佔用了 1.7GB 的空間，其中包括完整的 Python 安裝、完整的 Node.js 安裝，以及 Poppler、git 和 LibreOffice 開源檔案~/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/plugins/openai-primary-runtime/plugins/documents 資料夾包含一些技能，這些技能告訴 Codex 如何尋找和使用這些二進位檔案。標籤：codex、generative-ai、openai、ai、llms、openoffice、開源

items_all.title: GeoJSON Map Viewer
items_all.summary: Tool: GeoJSON Map Viewer I was helping Natalie gather some maps of local political boundaries (for the Granada Community Services District and the Midcoast Community Council and found a need to display some GeoJSON files on a map and export that as a PNG. I asked GPT-5.6-Sol for suggestions of tools and it proactively built one. After some iterations using Claude Code for web and Fable 5.1 we got to this finished tool. As for the GeoJSON.. it turns out if you ask ChatGPT Work to provide boundaries for almost anything it will churn away extracting and combining files from different Government data sources and build exactly what you need. I got this polygon from: I want a polygon that represents the exact boundary of the El Granada GCSD And this one from: Get me a GeoJSON file for the boundary (or boundaries if that makes sense) for the MCC - Midcoast Community Council - that operates near Half Moon Bay CA Here's a link that displays both of them at the same time on the new GeoJSON map viewing tool. items_all.title: datasette-mcp 0.2
items_all.summary: Release: datasette-mcp 0.2 "rows" from execute_sql is now an array of objects. Previously it was an array of arrays. This should help weaker models avoid losing track of which positional array element maps to which column. #1 Now depends on mcp>=2.1.1 . This is the first non-alpha release of the plugin. I'm confident it's ready as I've been using it quite a bit myself. Tags: datasette , model-context-protocol
items_all.summary_zh: 發布：datasette-mcp 0.2 版本中，execute_sql 傳回的「rows」現在是一個物件數組。之前它是一個陣列的陣列。這應該有助於較弱的模型避免遺失數組中每個位置元素與對應列的對應關係。 #1 現在依賴 mcp>=2.1.1。這是該插件的第一個非 alpha 版本。我自己已經使用過一段時間，所以我相信它已經準備就緒。標籤：datasette，模型上下文協議

items_all.title: Python 3.15.0 candidate 2 is here!
items_all.summary: Python 3.15.0 candidate 2 is here! Hugo van Kemenade (release manager for Python 3.14 and 3.15) announces the final release candidate for Python 3.15, scheduled for release in October: Entering the release candidate phase, only reviewed code changes which are clear bug fixes are allowed between this release candidate and the final release. [...] We strongly encourage maintainers of third-party Python projects to prepare their projects for 3.15 during this phase, and publish Python 3.15 wheels on PyPI to be ready for the final release of 3.15.0, and to help other projects do their own testing. Any binary wheels built against Python 3.15.0 release candidates will work with future versions of Python 3.15. Back in 2021 I found a bug in Python 3.10 by running my test suites against it... but I hadn't done this during the RC period, so that bug had already shipped! Since then I've always paid much closer attention to these RCs. The new RC isn't available for GitHub Actions just yet - keep an eye on actions/python-versions for that. For the moment though you can add this to a testing matrix: strategy : matrix : python-version : ["3.14", "3.15"] steps : - uses : actions/setup-python@v7 with : python-version : ${{ matrix.python-version }} allow-prereleases : true check-latest : true The allow-prereleases and check-latest flags mean that today this will test against RC1, and when RC2 lands it will automatically switch to that version (and then the stable version once that comes out.) Update : Datasette passes , sqlite-utils passes , LLM is currently blocked waiting for a 3.15 wheel f

items_all_raw.title: Claude Fable 5.1 made me a really nice animated pelican
items_all_raw.summary: Today is Claude Fable (and Mythos) 5.1 day . Anthropic say that Fable 5.1 "sets a new standard for coding, knowledge work, and long-running problem-solving tasks". Their announcement spends a notable amount of time on scientific research, boasting of a 52.6% score on the brand new Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 benchmark (first announced on August 27th ), up from 24.7% for Fable 5, 29.0% for Opus 5 and 22.4% for GPT-5.6 Sol. Other benchmarks show slightly improved scores, but none as impressive as the Science one. But how well can it pelican? Back in July I wrote about how I was losing faith in the pelican benchmark - its connection to how good the models were at other tasks didn't seem to hold as strongly as it did back in 2025 . The most interesting insights I get from it now are comparisons within model families, and particularly comparisons for the same prompt at different reasoning effort levels. Fable 5.1 has five reasoning levels: low, medium, high, xhigh, max - and no option to turn off reasoning entirely. I fixed an issue in llm-anthropic which caused reasoning traces not to be correctly recorded, then ran some prompts. Here's the full set of pelicans for all of the reasoning levels, each with the full reasoning transcript. I'll replicate them here: Low and medium, both without reasoning? Next, a bit of a mystery. This is what I got for effort low : The transcript doesn't show any summarized reasoning tokens, and the output token count is 1,998. With Claude that output token count includes reasoning tokens. It took 23.8 seconds and cost 10.017 cents . I bumped that up
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 今天是 Claude Fable（以及 Mythos）5.1 版本發布日。 Anthropic 聲稱 Fable 5.1「為編碼、知識工作和長時間運行的問題解決任務樹立了新的標竿」。他們的公告用了大量篇幅介紹科學研究，並自豪地宣稱其在全新的 Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 基準測試（於 8 月 27 日首次發布）中取得了 52.6% 的分數，高於 Fable 5 的 24.7%、Opus 5 的 29.0% 和 Fable 5 的 1其他基準測試的分數略有提高，但沒有一項能像科學基準測試那樣令人印象深刻。但是，它的表現究竟如何呢？早在 7 月份，我就寫過我對 Pelican 基準測試失去信心——它與模型在其他任務上的表現之間的關聯性似乎不如 2025 年時那麼強了。現在我從中獲得的最有趣的見解是模型家族內部的比較，特別是同一提示在不同推理難度下的比較。 Fable 5.1 有五個推理難度：低、中、高、超高和最高——而且沒有完全關閉推理的選項。我修復了 llm-anthropic 中的一個問題，該問題導致推理軌跡無法正確記錄，然後運行了一些提示。以下是所有推理難度下的完整鵜鶘圖集，每個圖集都包含完整的推理記錄。我將在這裡復現它們：低難度和中難度，都沒有推理？接下來，有點神祕。這是我在低難度下得到的結果：記錄中沒有顯示任何總結的推理標記，輸出標記數為 1,998。而 Claude 的輸出標記數包含推理標記。耗時 23.8 秒，成本為 10.017 美分。我提高了這個值。 GPT-5.6 Sol

items_all_raw.title: Palo Alto CEO says $1 trillion of cybersecurity infrastructure isn’t ready for AI

items_all_raw.title: Anthropic opens Claude AI text detection to regulators, media, fact-checkers, and others
items_all_raw.summary: Anthropic is launching an API that lets regulators, media outlets, and researchers check whether text carries Claude's digital watermark. The EU AI Act now requires invisible watermarks in AI-generated text. Critics warn the technology could hurt text quality and create transparency problems where contracts ban AI use. The article Anthropic opens Claude AI text detection to regulators, media, fact-checkers, and others appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Anthropic 正在推出一個應用程式介面 (API)，允許監管機構、媒體和研究人員檢查文字是否帶有 Claude's 數位浮水印。歐盟人工智慧法案現已要求在人工智慧生成的文字中新增不可見的浮水印。批評人士警告稱，這項技術可能會損害文字品質，並在合約禁止使用人工智慧的情況下造成透明度問題。文章《Anthropic 向監管機構、媒體、事實查核機構和其他機構開放 Claude 人工智慧文字偵測功能》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items_all_raw.title: Codex bundles LibreOffice
items_all_raw.summary: I was poking around in my ~/.cache/ folder using OmniDiskSweeper when I spotted something interesting. The OpenAI Codex desktop app (since rebranded to just ChatGPT) has 1.7GB of stuff in there in a folder called codex-primary-runtime , including a full Python installation, a full Node.js installation, and native binaries for Poppler , git, and the LibreOffice open source office suite (which forked from OpenOffice.org in 2010): The ~/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/plugins/openai-primary-runtime/plugins/documents folder includes skills which tell Codex how to find and use those binaries. Tags: codex , generative-ai , openai , ai , llms , openoffice , open-source
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 當我用 OmniDiskSweeper 在我的 ~/.cache/ 資料夾裡閒逛時，發現了一些有趣的東西。 OpenAI Codex 桌面應用程式（現已更名為 ChatGPT）在名為 codex-primary-runtime 的資料夾中佔用了 1.7GB 的空間，其中包括完整的 Python 安裝、完整的 Node.js 安裝，以及 Poppler、git 和 LibreOffice 開源檔案~/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/plugins/openai-primary-runtime/plugins/documents 資料夾包含一些技能，這些技能告訴 Codex 如何尋找和使用這些二進位檔案。標籤：codex、generative-ai、openai、ai、llms、openoffice、開源

items_all_raw.title: Python 3.15.0 candidate 2 is here!
items_all_raw.summary: Python 3.15.0 candidate 2 is here! Hugo van Kemenade (release manager for Python 3.14 and 3.15) announces the final release candidate for Python 3.15, scheduled for release in October: Entering the release candidate phase, only reviewed code changes which are clear bug fixes are allowed between this release candidate and the final release. [...] We strongly encourage maintainers of third-party Python projects to prepare their projects for 3.15 during this phase, and publish Python 3.15 wheels on PyPI to be ready for the final release of 3.15.0, and to help other projects do their own testing. Any binary wheels built against Python 3.15.0 release candidates will work with future versions of Python 3.15. Back in 2021 I found a bug in Python 3.10 by running my test suites against it... but I hadn't done this during the RC period, so that bug had already shipped! Since then I've always paid much closer attention to these RCs. The new RC isn't available for GitHub Actions just yet - keep an eye on actions/python-versions for that. For the moment though you can add this to a testing matrix: strategy : matrix : python-version : ["3.14", "3.15"] steps : - uses : actions/setup-python@v7 with : python-version : ${{ matrix.python-version }} allow-prereleases : true check-latest : true The allow-prereleases and check-latest flags mean that today this will test against RC1, and when RC2 lands it will automatically switch to that version (and then the stable version once that comes out.) items_all_raw.title: Google's election AI Overviews are opaque, rely on few sources, and sometimes take sides
items_all_raw.summary: Using access granted under the EU's Digital Services Act, the German advocacy group AlgorithmWatch ran 4,480 election-related search queries on Google and analyzed the AI Overviews that came back. Google showed the overviews inconsistently and leaned on a small pool of sources, chief among them its own platform YouTube. Whether earlier safeguards against AI answers on election questions still apply, Google left open. The article Google's election AI Overviews are opaque, rely on few sources, and sometimes take sides appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 德國倡導組織AlgorithmWatch利用歐盟《數位服務法》授予的存取許可權，在Google平臺上進行了4480次與選舉相關的搜尋查詢，並分析了返回的AI概覽。 Google平臺顯示的概覽並不一致，且依賴少量資訊來源，其中最主要的是其自身的YouTube平臺。 Google平臺並未明確說明先前針對AI在選舉議題上作答的保障措施是否仍然有效。文章《Google's選舉AI概覽晦澀難懂、資訊來源有限且有時帶有傾向性》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

items_all_raw.title: ChatGPT、Reddit及Roblox被納入歐盟《數位服務法》規範
items_all_raw.summary: 歐盟執委會（European Commission，EC）週一（8/31）宣佈，將ChatGPT納入《數位服務法》（Digital Services Act，DSA）超大型線上搜尋引擎（Very Large Online Search Engine，VLOSE）名單，Reddit與Roblox則被列為超大型線上平臺（Very Large Online Platform，VLOP），即日起適用DSA最嚴格規範，須於四個月內、即2027年1月前完成合規。

items_all_raw.title: 應對AI漏洞挑戰，FIRST國際資安應變組織擴大漏洞研討會規模
items_all_raw.summary: 當AI打破漏洞修補節奏，過往資安團隊尚有餘裕應對的漏洞修補時程，如今正被大幅壓縮，如何在漏洞被發現或遭AI加速利用之前重新調整應對策略，已成為產業界迫切需要解決的課題，最近FIRST國際資安應變組織宣佈，將於9月23日至25日召開VulnOptiCON 2026，將原本的Vuln4Cast研討會更名並擴大舉辦，不僅將會期拉長為3日，議程主軸也從原本以漏洞預測技術為核心，擴大納入漏洞追蹤、CVE計畫前景，以及AI如何改變漏洞發現及利用等議題，以涵蓋更廣泛的漏洞生態系統主題。

items_all_raw.title: Why MCP servers are becoming AI’s newest attack surface
items_all_raw.summary: As AI adoption gathers pace, so does the evolution of the infrastructure that supports it. New standards and connectors keep appearing, and the ones that catch on spread through the ecosystem within months rather than years. That speed strengthens what AI can do, but makes it very difficult for security teams to maintain sufficient protections. […] The post Why MCP servers are becoming AI’s newest attack surface appeared first on AI News .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 隨著人工智慧的普及，支撐其發展的基礎設施也加速演進。新的標準和連接器層出不窮，那些被廣泛接受的方案往往只需幾個月而非幾年就能在整個生態系統中傳播開來。這種快速發展增強了人工智慧的能力，但也使得安全團隊難以維持足夠的防護。 […] 這篇文章《為什麼 MCP 伺服器正成為人工智慧最新的攻擊面》最初發表於 AI News。
